summary: PowerCompute, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, US Digital Mining Mississippi LLC, entered into an Industrial Power Contract with Columbus Light and Water on September 30, 2026, effective September 16, 2026, replacing a prior power contract for its Columbus, Mississippi data center. Terms cover up to 11,000 kilowatts of firm power through September 16, 2030, with a five-year renewal option by mutual agreement, priced under CLW's Large Data Service Rate subject to TVA adjustments. No special-situation event; no deal terms or recommendation.
